items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I think Chink was playing bass with me

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Harry was playing alto sax. And they had one of the sweetest bands I ever heard gotten together in this town at the, Pete Hyman's ringside. Freddie Newman on piano. They had, I think Chink was playing bass with me, if I remember right. I know Harry and Sidney Reedman. Boy, but they had some three-way harmony with that group, Paul, was out of this world. That's one of the only bands I can remember, Dixieland bands, where you could…
I don't think they would be reading much, either.
